plan.title: What is Agentic AI?
plan.subtitle: AI that plans and acts on its own

slides.heading: Beyond Just Answers
slides.body: Most AI answers questions or suggests ideas. Agentic AI goes further by deciding what to do and taking actions independently.

slides.heading: How Agentic AI Works
slides.body: It creates a plan to reach a goal, then takes steps based on what it learns, without needing constant human input.

slides.heading: Why It Matters
slides.body: Agentic AI can handle complex tasks, like managing projects or controlling robots, opening new possibilities across many fields.
